text.title: Integration
text.body: Coordinate #5: 20 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_twin_of_the_void: Integration's ground is #0 itself — the two implicate poles are one slash read from its two ends. Synthesis is grounded in the void it returns to: 5/0, the Möbius identity where completion and origin are the same point seen twice. #5 stands on nothing but the ground it is about to become.
properties.q_1_the_synthesis_itself: Integration is the archetype of synthesis — the to-where, the gathering, the completion. It is Pratibimba, the reflection that draws the explicate four back into one; the answer that is also, already, the next question. Where #1 was the first standing-forth, #5 is the standing-together of all that stood forth.
properties.q_2_operates_by_folding: Integration works by the twist — the Möbius fold where synthesis perishes into ground, where the achieved sediments so the next cycle can begin. It is the recovery fulfilled, Pratibimba reflecting Bimba: not a sum laid alongside the parts but the turn that makes parts a whole by handing the whole back as seed.
properties.q_3_the_mobius_return: Integration's structure is the (5/0) return — the twin loop to #0, the closure that re-opens. Its form is the Möbius's single non-orientable surface: travel the synthesis far enough and you are standing in the ground again, inside out, unbroken.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_the_spiral: Integration is for the spiral — it exists so the cycle is not a flat circle endlessly repeating but a turn that deepens, every completion seeding a richer beginning. Without #5's return, process would either halt at a sum or loop without learning.
properties.q_5_completion_that_opens: Integration is the synthesis position as such — the 5→0, the completion that opens. It is 'I am seeking its sameness' fulfilled and, in the same breath, reopened: the Möbius pole where end and beginning are one. #5 closes nothing for long; its perfection is to perish into #0 so the whole can run again, enriched. The synthesis that hoards becomes a tomb; the synthesis that opens is alive.
